figurative_meaning_en: A statement full of sarcasm - a specific figure of speech
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথায় ব্যঙ্গোক্তি ছিল, যা শ্রোতাদের হাসিয়ে দিল।
লেখকের ব্যঙ্গোক্তি সমাজের দোষগুলো তুলে ধরে।
example_sentences_in_english: His words were full of sarcasm, which made the audience laugh.
The author's sarcastic remarks highlight the flaws in society.
history: Derived from Sanskrit rhetorical traditions, where 'vyangya' refers to implied meaning in poetics.
note: This term is more of a rhetorical device than a traditional proverb, rooted in classical Bengali literature.
